package.name: 3D Avatar Maker
package.description: Build a 3D avatar for a character or persona on its own Home tab: choose a body, shape it, pick skin, eyes, hair and clothes, then save it as a GLB file and import it under the 3D Avatars agent. No other software is needed. Alpha: the face doesn't move yet. Install it, then open Home → 3D Avatar Maker.
